description: Registers an Events custom post type with a read-only REST API endpoint for published events.

restEndpoints.description: Read-only endpoint that returns a JSON array of published events with id, title, permalink, event date, and location. Does not expose drafts or private posts.

dataStorage: Events stored as custom post type 'evtr_event' with post meta fields for event_date and event_location. All data cleaned up on uninstall.
securityRequirements: ABSPATH guard in all PHP files
Meta box uses wp_nonce_field/check_admin_referer + current_user_can capability check
Sanitize event_date and event_location on save with sanitize_text_field
REST endpoint only returns published posts (post_status = publish)
Escape all output in REST response (esc_url for permalink, esc_html for text fields)
No dynamic SQL needed; use WP_Query and get_post_meta
uninstall.php has WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN guard and uses $wpdb->prepare if needed for cleanup
